templates.title: Your first Strong {c7}
templates.body: That {c7} on the {client_first} call? That's the standard. Keep it.

templates.title: All seven, Strong
templates.body: Seven out of seven on one call. I'm putting that call in the training pack.

templates.title: Owning it
templates.body: You corrected yourself mid-call. Most people double down. You didn't.

templates.title: Review passed
templates.body: You passed. Not because you were perfect, but because your judgment held.

templates.title: Thirty days
templates.body: Thirty days of showing up. That's how good people become great at this.

templates.title: Your first team
templates.body: Rosa tells me you're ready to lead. I agree. Look after them.

templates.title: The unit is yours
templates.body: A quarter on probation, then the role is yours. I'll be watching the numbers and the people.

templates.title: Top Voice
templates.body: Your calls this month set the tone for the whole agency. Thank you.

templates.title: Thanks for trusting me
templates.body: Thanks for giving me {task}. I learned a lot doing it. — {teammate_first}

templates.title: That helped
templates.body: That conversation helped. I know what to do differently now. — {teammate_first}

templates.title: Breathing room
templates.body: Thanks for rebalancing the week. I can actually do good work again. — {teammate_first}

templates.title: Good talk

feedback_excellent.when: feedback_call scorecard with communication >= 85 and business >= 90

trust_9.when: client trust reaches 9 for the first time

turnaround.when: client status changes from at_risk to on_track

cycle_clean.when: client's 3-call cycle completed with no incidents

top_voice.display: ‘Top Voice · <Month YYYY>’ (or ‘Top Voice in Claims · <Month>’) on profile, leaderboard row and appreciation wall

employee_of_month.rule: #1 by monthly Career Points within each title group among leaderboard participants; ties → higher avg communication, then earlier
